summary: Yum China Holdings filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Willow Glade Investments, LLC from Yum! Brands for US$1.2 billion in cash, closing August 7, 2026. Willow Glade holds Pizza Hut intellectual property and related rights in mainland China. Concurrently, Yum China amended and restated the KFC/Taco Bell master license agreement to remove Pizza Hut references and secure potential annual financial incentives over twelve years based on KFC system sales growth targets. Financing was provided via a CNH8.4 billion bridge credit facility. The transaction eliminates future Pizza Hut royalties and consolidates brand ownership; watch for integration execution and royalty savings realization.
